_comment: The single source of model routing. The repository ships agents unpinned; scripts/install.mjs injects these lines into the copies it makes. The lead inherits the TUI selection and morph inherits the session model, taking the card's model tier per seam: workhorse codes and tests, thinker reasons, reviews and verifies, generalist covers the rest. Two seats, three tiers, nothing else: role knowledge travels as cards in roles/, not as agents.
